name: Adaptive comparators for PAC-h, v1 (corrected re-run)
written: 2026-11-09, after the exploratory v0 runs (protocol_baselines.json, addendum A1) and an independent review of them; before any v1 calibration or test run
v0_status: v0 outputs are kept unchanged as exploratory; v1 replaces them for any reporting

corrections_from_review.bacc_limit: the per-decision change limit applies to every issued target, including early (trigger) updates, measured from the last issued target
corrections_from_review.bacc_replan: Sect. III-E 'minimum sizing workload' read literally: sizing workload = max(calibrated peak of the latest regular decision, y_early); the v0 multiplicative reading is a sensitivity (V9)
corrections_from_review.bacc_hold: an early increase is held until Ready (decision index + tau); regular decisions before then do not go below it
corrections_from_review.aci_event_time: all ACI quantities indexed by actual test target minutes 0..T-1; infinite and empty sets recorded as masks, not inferred from capacity
corrections_from_review.resource_bound: common resource bound M_u = max(1, ceil(2 max pre-period demand / mu)) applied to every controller (also the BACC replica bound and the ACI infinite-set substitute); PAC-h reported with and without the bound
corrections_from_review.aci_bound: ACI_BOUND.md: interleaved finite-horizon bound of the implemented algorithm; formal set errors, actual overload and exceptional overload (infinite set, bound binding, Alibaba initial prefix) reported separately
corrections_from_review.gamma_rule: primary: unchanged transfer rule (calibration days, tau = 0, gamma with positive alpha* for the calibration period; most units within budget, then lower mean cost); test cells whose selected gamma gives alpha* <= 0 are reported as not applicable for that gamma. Revision R1 (written after v0 results were known, labelled as such): for each test cell, the best-ranked calibration gamma among those with alpha* > 0 for that cell's tau and T

controllers.PAC-h: published configuration (pre-test window, eta = 0.05, horizon-aligned scores)
controllers.ACI: gamma = 0.005, alpha* = delta, W = PAC-h window, interleaved lanes
controllers.ACI-G: gamma by the rule above, alpha* = delta - (tau+1)(1+gamma)/(gamma T)
controllers.BACC-r: SOURCE_MAPPING.md; primary: c = mu, limit 100, A_k over all planned minutes, trigger on, replan floor, h = 5

bacc_sensitivities.V4: HPA-style limit (up at most max(4, planned), down unlimited)

cells: alibaba200, huawei2023, azure2019; delta in {0.01, 0.05}; tau in {0, 1, 5}
post_hoc_temporal_validation: same rules on the three Huawei confirmatory periods (days 0-18, 147-165, 168-184; 195 unit-runs): PAC-h with its published per-period windows, ACI, ACI-G (gamma chosen on each period's days 8-9 by the same rule), BACC-r primary; labelled as a post hoc baseline analysis, not confirmatory
reporting: per unit: overload fraction, relative cost and its parts (resource, churn, penalty); per cell: units within budget, units where both comply, paired median cost ratio, ratio of mean costs, upper tail of cost ratios, exceptional events; no single summary claim across budgets or cost statistics
freeze: manifest_v1.json lists SHA-256 of this protocol, the code, tests log, data inputs, selected gamma and package versions; it is self-recorded, not an external preregistration
